name: Wakatsuki Takuya
source:
He is a second-year student at the school, gentle and has a pleasant personality. He is optimistic, but sometimes takes a long time to take the first step. Additionally, he can be overly cautious and gets lost in his thoughts.

He admires having a girlfriend and decided to work hard to achieve that goal after becoming a second-year student.
